{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

data_dict = '''Variable name:       Description
------------------------
patient_id:          Unique identifier for each patient
sex:                 Gender of the patient (M, F)
treatment:         Treatment group (A, B)
response:          Binary outcome: 1 = responded, 0 = did not respond
age:                 Age of the patient in years
baseline_score:      Pre-treatment score on a clinical scale (0-100)

Note: Treatment A is the control; Treatment B is the experimental treatment.'''

def print_data_summary(df):
    print('=== Data Summary ===')
    print(df.head())
    print(f'\nShape: {df.shape}')
    print(f'\nData types:\n{df.dtypes}')
    print(f'\nMissing values:\n{df.isnull().sum()}')
    print(f'\nDuplicated rows: {df.duplicated().sum()}')
    print(f'\nUnique values in sex: {df["sex"].unique()}')
    print(f'\nUnique values in treatment: {df["treatment"].unique()}')
    print(f'\nResponse rate overall: {df["response"].mean():.3f}')
    print(f'\nMean age: {df["age"].mean():.1f} years')
    print(f'\nMean baseline score: {df["baseline_score"].mean():.1f}')
    
print_data_summary(trial_df)"}
